map.常测肱三头肌、肩胛下角、髂前上棘（腹部）；男性也可胸+腹+大腿。捏起皮褶与皮下脂: Common sites are the triceps, the inferior angle of the scapula and the anterior superior iliac spine (abdomen); men can also use chest + abdomen + thigh. Pinch the skinfold plus the subcutaneous fat (excluding fascia), read it in mm and average 2-3 readings; keeping the same measurer is most reliable.
